headline: Capita stock tumbles after pension delays
standfirst: The company's boss resigned following major issues with public sector pension payments.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Capita shares fell 70 percent. The company's leader resigned amid ongoing pension failures.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Capita took over managing public sector pension schemes last year. Payments are now delayed.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: Workers rely on these payments. A major government contractor is failing at a critical task.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: See how the government addresses the payment backlog and who takes over the leadership role.

caption:
Capita shares have dropped 70 percent following the resignation of the company boss over pension payment failures.

Public sector workers are facing significant delays to their pension payments. This comes after Capita took over the scheme administration last year. Reliable pension management is essential for government workers.
